scenes.name: THE CAYLEY BRIDGE
lines: Textbooks turn space with e to the X, an endless series that computers must cut short.
教科书用 e^X 转动空间：那是一串无穷级数，计算机只能把它截断。
Cayley's bridge needs one division, by I minus X, whose determinant is one plus the squared length of sigma, never zero.
凯莱桥只需一次除法：除以 I − X，它的行列式等于 1 加 σ 的模方，永不为零。
Feed in one half, one half, zero: a matrix of thirds, orthogonal, with determinant one.
代入 (½, ½, 0)：得到一个全是三分之几的矩阵，正交，行列式为 1。

scenes.name: TWELVE TURNS
lines: Turn zero, zero, one twelve times: the denominator reaches three to the twelfth, the squared length stays one.
把 (0, 0, 1) 连转十二次：分母涨到 3¹²，模方始终是 1。
A Taylor step multiplies it by seventeen sixteenths, and twelve steps carry it past two.
二阶泰勒截断每一步把模方乘以 17/16，十二步后超过 2。
Lean checks that Cayley turns keep length for every rational generator and every step count.
Lean 内核检验：对任意有理生成元、任意步数，凯莱迭代都保持模方。

scenes.name: TWO CHARTS
lines: Composing two turns in one chart divides by a number that can reach zero.
在单张坐标卡里合成两次转动，要除以一个可能变成零的数。
The dual chart keeps two denominators whose shares add to one, and divides by the larger, never below one half.
双卡保留两个分母，份额相加为 1；总除以较大者，其份额不低于一半。
Here D plus has only one sixth, so the shadow chart takes over, and lands inside the unit ball.
这里 D₊ 只占六分之一，于是阴影卡接手，结果落在单位闭球之内。
Lean checks the half floor for every rational pair, by a constructive split on a sign.
Lean 内核对任意一对有理输入检验了这条半界，只靠对一个符号的构造性分情形。

scenes.name: NO SQUARE ROOT
lines: The quaternion one, one, zero, zero has squared norm two, which is not a square.
整四元数 (1, 1, 0, 0) 的模方是 2，而 2 不是平方数。
Normalizing needs root two, but p and p bar fuse the two roots into a plain two.
归一化要用 √2；可伴随作用两边乘 p 与 p̄，两个根号合成一个普通的 2。
Every entry is now an integer: an exact quarter turn about the first axis.
约掉之后每个元素都是整数：绕第一轴恰好转 90°。
Lean checks that this square-root-free action keeps every rational dot product.
Lean 内核检验：这个无根号伴随作用保持一切有理内积。

scenes.name: CHEBYSHEV BEATS
lines: Now let time step: start at one, then three fifths plus four fifths i, with overlap three fifths.
现在让时间走起来：从 1 出发，下一拍是 3/5 + 4/5·i，两者内积为 3/5。
The heap rule turns linear, six fifths of this beat minus the last, and each overlap is a Chebyshev value.
递推化为线性：下一拍 = 6/5 × 这一拍 − 上一拍；内积都是切比雪夫值。
Twenty beats on, the denominator is five to the twentieth, and the norm is still exactly one.
走到第二十拍，分母是 5²⁰，模方仍然恰好是 1。
Lean checks the unit norm for signed spinors, and on the classical side, the Chebyshev form.
Lean 内核检验：有号旋量每拍保持单位模方；经典一侧另验切比雪夫闭式。

scenes.name: WHERE PI ENTERS
lines: Pi enters only when a turn is stretched along a real time line, and a doubling reading is made continuous there.
只有把转动沿实数时间轴拉直、并要求倍角读数在其上连续，π 才出现。
Lean checks, on the classical side, that it must be cosine squared, with two pi squared in the period.
Lean 内核在经典实数一侧检验：这个读数只能是余弦平方，周期里带着 2π²。
The sphere needs no pi: six integer axes of norm five, each capped where twice the overlap squared beats five.
球面也不需要 π：六根模方为 5 的整数轴，帽子条件是 2⟨x, 轴⟩² > 5。
Lean checks that the six caps cover the sphere, with no perpendicular pair in any cap.
Lean 内核检验：六顶帽子盖满球面，且没有一顶装得下一对垂直方向。
In the chapter's reading, pi is the price of a real clock.
按本章的解读，π 是实数时钟的代价。

scenes.name: END
lines: Turns, charts and rhythms, all from exact fractions.
转动、双卡与节拍，全都出自精确的分数。
